description: Defines a custom Serializer class extending SymfonySerializer for JSON:API, overriding normalization and denormalization methods, and managing fallback normalizers within Drupal's JSON:API module.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: A custom serializer class for JSON:API in Drupal, extending SymfonySerializer and implementing JsonSchemaProviderSerializerInterface, with fallback normalization support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the serializer, ensuring only allowed normalizers are added.

methods.name: setFallbackNormalizer
methods.description: Sets a fallback normalizer for use when JSON:API cannot normalize an object.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes data, using self support check and fallback normalizer.

methods.name: denormalize
methods.description: Denormalizes data, using self support check and fallback normalizer.

methods.name: supportsNormalization
methods.description: Checks if data can be normalized by this serializer or fallback.

methods.name: selfSupportsNormalization
methods.description: Checks if this class alone supports normalization for given data.

methods.name: supportsDenormalization
methods.description: Checks if data can be denormalized by this serializer or fallback.

methods.name: selfSupportsDenormalization
methods.description: Checks if this class alone supports denormalization for given data.
